post.description: Registers a user with a password of at least 12 characters. 409 if the email is taken.

post.summary: Sign in with email and password
post.description: Returns an access token in the body. The refresh token is set as an HttpOnly cookie.

post.summary: Swap the refresh cookie for a new access token and a new refresh token
Sign out: revoke this session's refresh tokens and clear the cookie

get.description: Returns every contribution cycle defined for this stokvel.

post.description: Defines a new collection period for this stokvel, e.g. "2026-09" with a target amount.

get.description: Returns one contribution cycle. 404 if it does not exist for this stokvel.

put.description: Replaces a cycle's label and target amount.

get.description: One response covering every stokvel the caller belongs to: their role, the current cycle, what they paid, what they still owe (integer cents) and the next payout date (UTC). A caller in no stokvels gets an empty list.

post.summary: Process the next payout for a stokvel's contribution cycle
post.description: Determines the next eligible recipient by join order, creates a Payout record, and marks the cycle as paid out -- both writes succeed or fail together.

post.summary: Record a contribution (requires an Idempotency-Key header)
Add a member to a stokvel

delete.summary: Remove a member from a stokvel

get.description: Returns every stokvel, with its member COUNT (not the full member list). Use GET /api/stokvels/{id}/members for the full list.

post.description: Creates a new stokvel. Contribution amount must be positive with at most 2 decimal places. Max members must be between 2 and 50.

get.description: Returns a single stokvel. 404 if no stokvel with that id exists.

put.description: Fully replaces a stokvel's name, contribution amount, frequency and max members. Fails with 409 if the new max members would be lower than the current member count.

delete.description: Deletes a stokvel and all of its memberships.

get.description: Returns every registered user, ordered by last name then first name.

post.description: Creates a new user. Requires a non-blank first/last name, a valid-looking unique email address, and a date of birth showing the person is at least 18 years old.

get.description: Returns a single user. 404 if no user with that id exists.

put.description: Fully replaces a user's first name, last name, email and date of birth.

delete.description: Deletes a user. Fails with 409 if the user is still a member of any stokvel.

Bearer.description: Paste the accessToken returned by POST /api/auth/login.
